entities.name: 7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine synthase
observations: The 234-residue query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q9ZCV2 from Rickettsia prowazekii.
Contains a Radical_SAM domain at positions 53–133 and the conserved three-cysteine motif consistent with [4Fe-4S] binding.
Annotated cofactors are a [4Fe-4S] cluster, S-adenosyl-L-methionine, and Mg2+.
Annotated as a homodimer and assigned EC 4.3.99.3.

entities.name: tRNA queuosine biosynthesis
observations: 7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine synthase performs an early shared step in 7-deazapurine biosynthesis, including the pathway leading to tRNA queuosine modification at position 34.

entities.name: 6-carboxy-tetrahydropterin
observations: Substrate of 7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine synthase in the radical-mediated CPH4-to-CDG transformation.

entities.name: 7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine
observations: Product of the reaction catalyzed by 7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine synthase and precursor to 7-deazapurine compounds.
